states.errorBody: Check the connection and try again. If it keeps happening, quote the reference.
states.deniedBody: Your role does not include the permission this needs. Ask the owner or a manager to grant it.
states.notFoundBody: It may have been removed, or the link is wrong.

dirty.title: Leave without saving?
dirty.body: Your changes on this page have not been saved.

stepUp.title: Confirm with your authenticator
stepUp.body: This change needs a fresh code from your authenticator app. It counts for five minutes.

conflict.title: Someone else changed this
conflict.body: It changed after you opened it. Reload to see the current version, then make your change again.

table.ascending: A to Z, low to high, oldest first
table.descending: Z to A, high to low, newest first
table.sortScope: Sorts the rows on this page. Search and filters reach the whole list.

codes.ACCOUNT_INVALID: This account cannot be saved that way.
codes.ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS_AVAILABLE: The payment allocates more than is still owed on those invoices.
codes.APPROVAL_ALREADY_DECIDED: Someone has already decided this request, or it was withdrawn.
codes.APPROVAL_EXPIRED: This request waited too long and has lapsed. The person who asked must ask again.
codes.APPROVAL_PENDING: A request for this is already waiting for approval.
codes.APPROVAL_SUBJECT_CHANGED: The record changed after this request was made, so it cannot be decided. The person who asked must ask again.
codes.ARCHIVE_HASH_MISMATCH: The archived copy no longer matches what was issued, so it was not printed. Nothing was changed. Tell the owner: this has been logged as an error.
codes.BANK_ACCOUNT_INVALID: This bank or mobile money account cannot be saved that way.
codes.BILLING_DOCUMENT_INVALID: This document cannot be issued as it stands.
codes.CAPACITY_BELOW_BOOKED: The slot already has more orders booked than that capacity.
codes.CART_NOT_ACTIVE: This basket is already at the checkout or has been ordered.
codes.CHALLENGE_EXPIRED: That step took too long. Start again.
codes.CHECKOUT_NOT_OPEN: This checkout has closed. Go back to the basket and start again.
codes.COUPON_ALREADY_APPLIED: A coupon is already applied to this basket.
codes.COUPON_INVALID: That coupon code is not valid.
codes.COUPON_UNAVAILABLE: That coupon cannot be used now.
codes.CREDIT_NOTE_EXCEEDS_INVOICE: The credit note is more than the invoice has left to credit.
codes.CREDIT_NOTE_EXCEEDS_ORIGINAL: The credit note is more than the original document has left to credit.
codes.CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID: Your session needs refreshing. Reload the page and try again.
codes.DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE: We do not deliver to that address yet.
codes.DELIVERY_ZONE_INVALID: That delivery zone is not set up correctly.
codes.DEPRECIATION_RUN_EXISTS: Depreciation has already been run for that period.
codes.DEPRECIATION_RUN_INVALID: Depreciation cannot be run for that period.
codes.DOCUMENT_NOT_ARCHIVED: This document has no archived copy to print yet.
codes.DUPLICATE_SUPPLIER_INVOICE: This supplier invoice has already been entered.
codes.DUPLICATE_VALUE: That value is already in use.
codes.EVIDENCE_NOT_SCANNED: The photograph is still being checked. Try again in a minute.
codes.FIELD_SERVER_ASSIGNED: The server gives that value; it is never typed. Reload the page and try again.
codes.FILE_NOT_CLEAN: The file is still being checked for viruses, or it failed the check. Wait a moment, or use another file.
codes.FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: This kind of file cannot be used here. For a photograph, use a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture.
codes.FIXED_ASSET_INVALID: This asset cannot be saved that way.
codes.FORBIDDEN: Your role does not allow this.
codes.GOODS_RECEIPT_INVALID: This goods receipt cannot be saved as it is.
codes.GRANT_INVALID: That access cannot be given this way.
codes.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED: The request was incomplete. Try again.
codes.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This looks like a repeat of an earlier request with different details. Reload and try again.
codes.IMPORT_ENTITY_NOT_AVAILABLE: This kind of import is not available yet.
codes.IMPORT_NOT_VALIDATED: Check the file first, then apply it.
codes.INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: There is not enough stock for this.
codes.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email, phone number or password is not right.
codes.INVALID_CURSOR: The list changed while you were paging through it. Go back to the first page.
codes.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: This record is no longer in a state that allows this. Reload to see where it stands.
codes.INVOICE_MAKER_CANNOT_APPROVE: You entered this invoice, so you cannot approve it. Ask someone else.
codes.JOURNAL_UNBALANCED: The journal's debits and credits do not match.
codes.LIVESTOCK_RECORD_INVALID: This livestock record cannot be saved as it is.
codes.LOCATION_INVALID: That location cannot be used for this.
codes.MAKER_CANNOT_CHECK: You made this request, so you cannot approve or reject it. Someone else with the approving permission must decide it.
codes.MANUAL_JOURNAL_INVALID: This journal cannot be saved that way.
codes.MORTALITY_PHOTO_REQUIRED: This loss is above the approval limit, so it needs a photograph. Report it again with a photograph.
codes.NOT_FOUND: This record was not found. It may have been removed.
codes.OPENING_ALREADY_POSTED: The opening balances have already been posted.
codes.ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED: This request came from a page the server does not accept. Reload the console and try again.
codes.PASSWORD_BREACHED: That password appears in a list of breached passwords. Choose a different one.
codes.PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED: Change your password before you carry on.
codes.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large. A photograph must be under 5 MB, a document under 10 MB.
codes.PAYMENT_METHOD_INVALID: That payment method is not set up correctly.
codes.PAYOUT_MAKER_CANNOT_APPROVE: You changed this supplier's payout details, so you cannot approve the first payment after it.
codes.PERIOD_NOT_OPEN: The accounting period for that date is locked or closed.
codes.POSTING_RULE_INVALID: This posting rule cannot be saved that way.
codes.POSTING_RULE_MISSING: The ledger has no posting rule for this yet. Ask the accountant.
codes.PREVIEW_DATA_REQUIRED: This template has no sample data to preview with. Add sample data and try again.
codes.PRICE_ENTRY_DUPLICATE: This price is already on the list.
codes.PRICE_ENTRY_INVALID: This price cannot be saved as it is.
codes.PRICE_LIST_ASSIGNMENT_INVALID: That price list cannot be assigned this way.
codes.PROCESSING_ORDER_INVALID: This processing order cannot do that.
codes.PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: That item cannot be bought online now.
codes.PROMOTION_INVALID: This promotion cannot be saved as it is.
codes.PURCHASE_ORDER_INVALID: This purchase order cannot do that.
codes.PURCHASE_REQUISITION_INVALID: This requisition cannot be saved that way.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
codes.RATION_INVALID: This ration cannot be saved as it is.
codes.RECEIPT_EXCEEDS_ORDER: More is being received than the purchase order has left to receive.
codes.RECEIPT_ORDER_MISMATCH: A line does not match the purchase order it names.
codes.RECORD_IN_USE: This is still in use, so it cannot be archived.
codes.REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: Something this refers to was not found. It may have been archived.
codes.REORDER_RULE_INVALID: This reorder rule cannot be saved as it is.
codes.REPORT_PERIOD_INVALID: That period cannot be reported on.
codes.REQUEST_TO_BUY_ONLY: Live animals are sold by request: ask for a quote instead.
codes.ROLE_INVALID: This role cannot be saved as it is.
codes.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is busy or down for a moment. Try again shortly.
codes.SETTING_INVALID: That setting cannot take that value.
codes.SLOT_REQUEST_INVALID: Those delivery slots cannot be set up that way.
codes.SLOT_UNAVAILABLE: That delivery slot cannot be booked. Choose another.
codes.STEP_UP_REQUIRED: Enter a code from your authenticator app to confirm this.
codes.STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_INVALID: This adjustment cannot be saved as it is.
codes.STOCK_EXCEPTION_INVALID: This stock exception cannot be resolved that way.
codes.STOCK_HOLD_INVALID: This hold cannot be changed that way.
codes.STOCK_MOVEMENT_ALREADY_REVERSED: This movement has already been reversed.
codes.STOCK_POLICY_CONFLICT: This conflicts with how this product's stock is kept.
codes.STOCK_REVERSAL_NOT_POSSIBLE: This movement cannot be reversed: the stock it moved has moved on.
codes.STOCK_TAKE_INVALID: This stock take cannot do that.
codes.STOCK_TAKE_NOT_COUNTED: Every line must be counted first.
codes.STOCK_UNAVAILABLE: There is not enough in stock for some items.
codes.STOCK_UNIT_ON_HOLD: That stock is under a hold, so it cannot be used.
codes.STOCK_UNIT_RESERVED: That stock is reserved for someone else.
codes.SUBLEDGER_REQUIRED: The ledger needs to know which customer, supplier or account this is for.
codes.SUPPLIER_DOCUMENT_INVALID: This supplier document cannot be saved that way.
codes.SUPPLIER_INVOICE_INVALID: This supplier invoice cannot do that.
codes.SUPPLIER_PAYMENT_INVALID: This supplier payment cannot do that.
codes.SUPPLIER_PROFILE_INVALID: This supplier profile cannot be saved that way.
codes.TAX_CELL_INVALID: This tax rate cannot be saved as it is.
codes.TAX_MATRIX_INCOMPLETE: Every tax rate must be filled in first.
codes.TAX_SCHEME_NOT_IN_FORCE: No tax scheme is in force for that date.
codes.TEMPERATURE_READING_INVALID: This temperature reading cannot be saved as it is.
codes.TEMPLATE_BODY_INVALID: The template cannot be saved as it is written.
codes.THREE_WAY_MATCH_FAILED: The invoice does not match its order and what was received.
codes.TOTP_ALREADY_ENROLLED: Two-step sign-in is already set up for this account.
codes.TOTP_INVALID: That code is wrong or has already been used.
codes.TRANSFER_VARIANCE: What arrived differs from what was sent.
codes.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
codes.UOM_CONVERSION_INVALID: This unit conversion cannot be saved.
codes.USER_INVALID: This user cannot be saved as it is.
codes.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of what was entered is not accepted. Check the fields marked below.
codes.VARIANCE_NOT_ALLOWED: This invoice's difference cannot be approved.
codes.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone changed this record while you had it open. Reload to see their change.
codes.WEIGHT_BAND_INVALID: This weight band cannot be saved as it is.
codes.WITHDRAWAL_CANNOT_BE_RELEASED: A withdrawal period cannot be released early: it ends when the medicine has cleared.
codes.YIELD_STANDARD_INVALID: This yield standard cannot be saved as it is.

rules.AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_LINE: A line is credited for more than it charged.
rules.BASE_UNIT: A unit cannot convert to itself.
rules.BATCH_NOT_EMPTY: The flock still has birds in it: sell, process or write them off first.
rules.FARM_BRANCH: It is the farm, where the animals are kept.
rules.HOLDS_STOCK: It still holds stock: move or sell it first.
rules.INEXACT_FACTOR: The conversion is not exact to three decimal places.
rules.LAST_ACTIVE_BRANCH: It is the only branch still open.
rules.LINE_ALREADY_CREDITED: A line has already been credited in full.
rules.NOT_COUNTABLE: Meat sold by weight cannot have a unit conversion: the weighed kilograms are charged.
rules.NOT_COUNTED: This product is not counted in units.
rules.NOT_SCANNED: Its file is still being checked for viruses. Try again in a moment.
rules.NO_THERMAL_RENDITION: It has no till-printer copy: print it on paper instead.
rules.OPEN_DOCUMENTS: It still has open documents: finish or cancel them first.
rules.ORIGINAL_NOT_CORRECTABLE: Only an issued invoice or receipt can be corrected.
rules.OUTPUT_CHANGED: Its output lots have changed since it was completed.
rules.OUTPUT_RESERVED: Some of its meat is reserved for an order.
rules.OUTPUT_SOLD: Some of its meat has been picked, sold or written off.
rules.QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_LINE: A line is credited for more than was sold on it.
rules.QUANTITY_OR_AMOUNT: Each line takes a quantity or an amount, not both.
rules.RENDERING: It is still being drawn up, which takes a few seconds after it is issued. Try again in a moment.
rules.SEX_FIXED_AS_DAM: This animal has a breeding record as a dam, so its sex cannot change.
rules.TAG_NOT_EDITABLE: An animal's tag cannot be changed: it is the stock record's identifier.

photo.offline: The photo was not sent: the connection dropped. Take it again when you have signal.
photo.failed: The photo was not sent. Try again.

copyId.label: Copy {{id}}
copyId.failed: Could not copy. Select it to copy by hand.
